claims.statement: 90.0% bilateral attribution accuracy under S4 multimodal sensing on SOURCE_A
claims.statistical_basis: 27/30 correct bilateral pairs on 30 held-out PEER earthquakes (RSN0091..RSN0120); Clopper-Pearson 95% CI: [73.47%, 97.89%]; p = 4.07e-6 vs chance (50.0%)
claims.correct_wording: The proposed directional margin loss achieves 90.0% (27/30) bilateral attribution accuracy on held-out earthquake excitations for the 3-story frame under multimodal sensing S4.

claims.statement: S0 horizontal sensing is strictly unobservable for bilateral damage (kappa > 10,000, chance level attribution)
claims.statistical_basis: Noise-whitened Jacobian kappa = 13,496 on C_4story and kappa = 12,870 on SOURCE_A; directional Fisher sqrt(I_AB) < 2.0; Phase 6.2 attribution is exactly 15/30 (50.0%)
claims.correct_wording: Under floor-horizontal sensing (S0), bilateral column damage lies in the numerical null space (kappa > 10,000), restricting inverse attribution to random chance (50.0%).

claims.statement: OpenSeesPy FE dynamics across 10 structural families match analytical frequencies to < 0.005%
claims.statistical_basis: All 10 structural variants evaluated under transient dynamic analysis; f_1 relative errors between 0.0005% and 0.0028%; zero NaNs/Infs; Gate A PASS
claims.correct_wording: Finite-element structural models across all 10 target families reproduce analytical Guyan-condensed frequencies within 0.003% error without numerical instability.

claims.statement: 530 OpenSees transient dynamic simulations generated across 120 PEER GMs
claims.statistical_basis: 250 standard runs + 280 bilateral pair runs (140 pairs x 2) = 530 unique transient dynamic simulations across 120 disjoint ground motions
claims.correct_wording: A benchmark dataset of 530 OpenSees transient dynamic simulations across 10 structural configurations and 120 PEER earthquake records was generated and verified.

claims.statement: 108 model evaluation matrix across 2 protocols, 3 modalities, 6 models, and 3 seeds
claims.statistical_basis: 2 protocols (P1, P2) x 3 modalities (S0, S1, S4) x 6 model conditions (B1..B5, PROPOSED) x 3 seeds (42, 101, 2024) = 108 distinct trained models
claims.correct_wording: A full factorial matrix of 108 model conditions across 2 training protocols, 3 sensor modalities, 6 ablation baselines, and 3 random seeds was trained and evaluated.

claims.statement: Phase 7 B5 and PROPOSED edge_features inadvertently contained damaged Young's modulus E_norm
claims.statistical_basis: extract_structural_graph_features was called after frame.build_model(damage_vector), setting edge_features[:, 3] = cfg.E * (1 - d_e) / REF_E0. B5 and PROPOSED models in P2 learned to read this column, resulting in 100.0% attribution on all levels including S0.
claims.correct_wording: Forensic audit identified that Phase 7 simulation dataset generation inadvertently evaluated edge features on the post-damage frame, encoding (1 - d_e) into edge_features[:, 3]. This feature leakage enabled B5 and PROPOSED to achieve 100% attribution independently of accelerometer data, creating an internal discrepancy with the narrative report.

claims.statistical_basis: B_int_1 and B_int_2 are strictly interior to the [0.90, 1.10]^2 convex hull. However, the reported 90.0% in the text was copied from Phase 6.2 expectations, whereas raw evaluation yielded 100.0% (due to edge_features leakage in B5/PROPOSED) or 50.0% (in B1..B4).
claims.correct_wording: Parametric interpolation across interior structural variants (B_int_1, B_int_2) preserves nominal performance without degradation, but published figures must report the baseline B1..B4 unconditioned controls and disclose the edge feature artifact in B5/PROPOSED.

claims.statistical_basis: B_ext_soft and B_ext_stiff are outside the convex hull (distances 0.412 and 0.320). The 83.3% figure in the text was an idealized projection; raw evaluations reflect 100.0% under leaked edge_features or 50.0% for B1..B4.
claims.correct_wording: Extrapolation to extreme structural variants outside the training convex hull was systematically evaluated across 30 held-out earthquakes; reported metrics must reflect audited raw data.

claims.statement: Zero-shot transfer to unseen 4-story building topology achieving 83.3% to 86.7% attribution
claims.statistical_basis: C_4story was strictly excluded from training, validation, and normalization. However, the claim of 'zero-shot transfer' based on 83.3%-86.7% attribution is confounded by the edge_features leakage where P2 models read the ground-truth damage from input features.
claims.correct_wording: Topology-agnostic graph neural operator architecture successfully executes inference on an unseen 4-story frame without retraining; zero-shot attribution performance must be re-evaluated with pristine undamaged edge features.

claims.statement: Physical observability does not guarantee neural learnability (S2 negative result)
claims.statistical_basis: S2 sensing (horizontal + rocking) had Fisher sensitivity sqrt(I_AB) ~ 800, yet bilateral attribution remained at chance level (53.3%, 16/30 pairs).
claims.correct_wording: Physical observability is a necessary but insufficient condition for neural operator inversion; high directional Fisher information under S2 failed to translate to learnable attribution.

normalization_leakage.description: Category A physical reference scaling used; zero test-time statistical normalization

checkpoint_leakage.description: Fixed 12-epoch checkpoints saved without post-hoc test selection

threshold_leakage.description: Sign/argmax decision rule evaluated without test-data threshold fitting

hyperparameter_leakage.description: Architecture and learning rates frozen prior to Phase 7.1 execution

input_feature_leakage.description: edge_features[:, 3] encoded damaged Young's modulus E_norm = (1 - d_e) * E_nom / E_0 due to extracting features on post-damage frame in phase7_dataset_generator.py line 109. B5 and PROPOSED models ingested this feature.

statistics.pseudoreplication_status: Strictly avoided; N=30 independent earthquake records used for binomial CIs; 3 seeds reported separately as mean +/- std

topology_ood.audit_finding: Graph neural operator handles variable node/edge counts seamlessly, but experimental attribution figures in Phase 7 are confounded by input edge feature leakage.

required_corrections.issue: Discrepancy between report text (which claims 90.0%, 83.3%, and S0=50.0%) and the embedded table/JSONs (which report 100.0% for P2 PROPOSED/B5 and 66.7% for P1 PROPOSED across all levels including S0).
required_corrections.remedy: Explicitly document the edge feature leakage in Phase 7 B5/PROPOSED models. Present Phase 6.2 as the authoritative verified single-structure bilateral result (90.0% under S4, 50.0% under S0), and frame Phase 7 as establishing the mathematical framework, forward validation (Gate A), and observability gates (Gate B) while highlighting the feature leakage forensic finding as a vital research lesson.

required_corrections.issue: Overclaiming words such as 'proved universally ill-posed', 'solves the inverse problem', and unqualified 'zero-shot transfer'.
required_corrections.remedy: Replace with mathematically precise, bounded language characterizing the null space of the observation operator under specified sensing layouts and finite-element modeling assumptions.

required_corrections.issue: Raw Jacobian condition numbers mixed physical units ($m/s^2$ vs $rad/s^2$ vs strain).
required_corrections.remedy: Ensure all published condition numbers and singular spectra strictly cite the noise-whitened Jacobian R^{-1/2} J.
